contradictions.reason: Constructor and eviction overstatements are resolved by proposal 0: traversal does not select an explicitly last or oldest effect, and lifetime increment tests the converted stored value.

The reparenting explanation is resolved by proposal 2. The canonical callee prepends an RObj constraint; rendered attachment names cannot establish child-list insertion.

Universal randomized emission and immediate generator removal are resolved by proposal 10, which also preserves the pending-work-before-mask exception.
